items.passage: Transcript: Good morning, this is Anouk Ferreira, coordinator for the music practice rooms. Normally you book practice rooms through the online calendar, in two-hour blocks. Jury week starts Monday, and that changes for a while. If you have a jury performance, you get first claim on the rooms with grand pianos, and you book those at the front desk of the music building, in ninety-minute blocks. Everyone else keeps using the online calendar, but blocks drop to one hour, so more people get a turn. Percussionists, your studio, Room 438, is being used for the juries themselves all week. Instead, you can practise in the rehearsal hall any time after six in the evening. There's no booking for that; just show up. If anything's unclear, call me at extension 2759.
